apps.localizedDescription: RyukGram (IG 410) is the same enhanced Instagram client ported to the Instagram 410.1.0 app for iOS 15 and later. It carries the full RyukGram feature set — follow-request tracking, read receipts, story-viewer insights, deleted-message logs, device-ID masking, media downloading, custom chat themes and a configurable tab bar — on top of the older Instagram base, which is what you want if the current Instagram builds are unstable on your device or you deliberately stay on an older app version.
